body:
# TBS themed disk 13 effects
**this mod is not perfect however I am trying to make the effect as close to the broken script as possible**

This is a simple paper/spigot plugin that when you play disc 13 black particles surround the jukebox referencing the broken script horror mod.

## Features
- Large dark smoke particles around jukeboxes
- Activates only when Music Disc 13 is playing
- Very Lightweight and simple
- No commands or config needed

## How to use
Its extremly easy to use:
1. Upload the plugin into the plugins folder
2. Restart / start server
3. Insert disc 13 in a juke box
   
Now your done

## Compatibility
- This plugin has not been fully tested
- Works on Paper / Spigot servers
- Designed for Minecraft 1.20+ (likely works on other versions)

### Notes
This plugin is inspired by the broken script horror mod.
[Click here for their modrinth page ](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-broken-script)

I am planning on improving this plugin to support more versions and loaders and be more accurite
